patch_branch_convention.notes: bundle_id_short is the first 16 chars of bundle.json.bundle_id (already 16 chars per schema). attr_path uses '/' replaced with '_' if present. CVE id prefix matches the canonical CVE-YYYY-NNNN form. Branch is created from the bundle's nixpkgs_rev (frozen at bundle creation time), patch applied, then pushed.

body_includes: link to the trace bundle ID + commit

trust_boundary.never_writes_to: NixOS/nixpkgs (upstream is read-only; PRs to upstream are a separate human-driven step)
trust_boundary.notes: trace produces bundles + opens PRs against the fork. A human reviewer on the trace side decides when (or if) any patch graduates from the fork to upstream. The fork is the staging ground; upstream submission is out of trace's automation scope.
